details: The United States may soon order strikes on Iran's "Pickaxe Mountain," a site reportedly housing nuclear facilities, according to President Donald Trump. This comes as the US Treasury Department imposed new sanctions on a Turkish bank accused of facilitating transactions for Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Quds Force. Both nations have recently intensified tit-for-tat military actions, with Iran targeting merchant vessels and the US striking IRGC locations. Iran reported 18 casualties from US attacks, including four civilians at a wedding. The six-month-old conflict remains at a stalemate, leading to increased oil prices and market caution.
title: US Threatens Iran Strikes, Imposes New Sanctions

details: The US economy added 162,000 nonfarm payrolls in August, significantly surpassing expectations and indicating a healthy labor market. This stronger-than-expected jobs report has increased the implied probability of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this month to approximately 58%. In response, US equity markets closed lower, and 2-year Treasury yields rose.
title: US August Job Growth Stronger Than Expected, Raises Rate Hike Odds

details: Canada has announced counter-tariffs on over 700 categories of US products, totaling $19.9 billion, effective September 8. This decision follows the collapse of trade talks with Washington. The move signals a further escalation in trade tensions between the two North American nations.
title: Canada to Impose Tariffs on $19.9 Billion US Goods
